frictions.name: Planned travel with better facilities
frictions.description: Hong Kong travel has hotel gym and pool access but no trusted in-person physio or lab access.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Use hotel-gym or remote substitutions; move labs outside travel.

frictions.name: Last-minute travel with limited facilities
frictions.description: Jakarta escalation has no reliable gym and restaurant-based meals.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Use remote coaching, hotel-room mobility, prepared-food rules, or unschedule high-load activities.

frictions.name: Provider availability mismatch with member preferences
frictions.description: Member prefers morning exercise, but the primary trainer has limited morning availability.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Try evening slots, remote trainer, or alternate days before unscheduling.

frictions.name: Lab or consultation disruption during travel
frictions.description: Fasting labs cannot be completed during travel because no partner lab is configured at travel destinations.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Schedule labs before travel and physician follow-up after labs.

frictions.name: Food prep dependency requiring chef or member prep
frictions.description: High-protein prepared meals require chef or member prep before consumption.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Place prep before meals, use no-prep substitution, or mark unsupported.

frictions.name: Equipment or facility unavailability
frictions.description: Sauna is unavailable during a July maintenance window.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Use breathwork, mobility, or ice bath if appropriate.

frictions.name: Physical-location travel-time conflict
frictions.description: Office-to-gym transfer requires at least 15 minutes.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Reject gym activities starting immediately after office blocks.

frictions.name: Skipped or substituted high-load activity requiring recovery adjustment
frictions.description: If high-load lower-body training is skipped after travel fatigue or knee discomfort, a recovery adjustment should be applied.
frictions.scheduler_expectation: Create or select lower-load recovery task and trace the adjustment.
